name: tty-footer-toggles
description: Footer toggle bar shows S, A and R toggles at startup with ctrl+ prefix; Ctrl+S shows and hides the toggle names; Ctrl+A and Ctrl+R cycle the toggles without corrupting the input area

steps.name: toggle bar appears in footer at startup with names hidden
Ctrl+S shows the toggle names
screenContains: ctrl+ Show toggle names Auto-run tools Read-only

steps.name: Ctrl+S again hides the toggle names
Ctrl+A cycles the auto-run toggle; names stay hidden
Ctrl+R cycles the read-only toggle; input area stays intact
typing still works after toggle keypresses
